clips.title: The story
paras: In Gnomeregan's Launch Bay, Electrocutioner 6000 guards the upper platform. The spider tank fights for Mekgineer Thermaplugg and the irradiated leper gnomes who follow him.

Mekgineer Thermaplugg and the irradiated leper gnomes who follow him took control of Gnomeregan's war machines after the city fell. Electrocutioner 6000 guards the upper platform of the Launch Bay, striking intruders with high-voltage current.
Electrocutioner 6000 guards the Workshop Key, which opens Gnomeregan's back door into its workshops. Bring down the machine, and the key offers a quicker route into the city's depths.
